uncited: - Input: A sparse measurement set (either a 2D image with missing pixels $I_{\text{sparse}}$ and mask $M$, or a 3D volume representation $V$ with reference projection $P$).
**Initialization**: Initialize the target array ($I_{\text{full}}$ or $V$) with known values or random/learned parameters.
**Projection/Forward Pass**: Map the current representation to the observation domain.
For compressive rendering, this is implicit in the error computation.
For compressive rendering, error is defined only on known pixels.
**Gradient Computation**: Compute gradients of the loss with respect to the representation parameters.
**Parameter Update**: Apply gradient descent to update the representation.
**Termination**: Stop when the change in the representation between iterations falls below a threshold or after a fixed number of iterations.
